description: Review of the DXF output (BH-004, BH-005, 20 Nov 2026): the DXF of a header-with-branch part stated neither its joint nor its surfaces, so the set-on joint with branch inside on header outside (Spec 02 section 4.4, the example radii of that section) and the same surfaces with the joint not declared produced byte-identical files, and no DXF stated its units in a machine-readable form. Engine 0.4.1 states the joint as declared ('set-on' or 'not declared') and the units (NF-UNITS: mm) in the 999 comment block and as TEXT annotations, and the independent reader and the quality gate compare the statement with the job. The verified cases must produce a file that passes the re-import check and the quality gate with the statement of the job; the refused case must be refused with the set-on pairing named. The cut geometry is unchanged from 0.4.0 (tests/compat.rs).
fixed_in: nf-engine 0.4.1: nf-dxf statement (JointStatement, write_stated, reimport_check_stated, quality_gate_stated, joint_statement rule); nf-core job.rs (the joint each part states; the records joint_statement_matches and the interface record declared)
